display_name: Leverage Shares 2X Short SPCX Daily ETF

about.en: SSPC is the Leverage Shares 2X Short SPCX Daily ETF, a leveraged inverse single-stock exchange-traded fund from Themes ETFs (Leverage Shares US) that seeks minus two times (-2x) the daily performance of Space Exploration Technologies Corp. shares (SPCX) before fees and expenses. Because the leverage resets daily, returns compound and can diverge substantially from -2x the share's performance over periods longer than one day. It is listed on Cboe BZX and is not a short position in SpaceX shares themselves.
